research_mode: official Building Safety Regulator and GOV.UK primary guidance only; high-rise accountable-person, risk-assessment, safety-management and resident-engagement methodology gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Higher-risk building threshold
verified_claims: A high-rise residential building has at least 7 storeys or is at least 18 metres high and has at least 2 residential units.
limitations: The threshold defines regulatory scope and does not establish the condition or risk level of a particular building.

sources.name: Registration before occupation
verified_claims: A higher-risk building must be registered with the Building Safety Regulator before people live there.
limitations: Registration status is an administrative requirement and does not prove that every safety risk is controlled.

sources.name: Accountable-person common-parts test
verified_claims: An accountable person is an organisation or individual that owns or has a legal obligation to repair common parts.
limitations: The role must be determined from ownership and repairing obligations, not inferred from a marketing or management label.

sources.name: Principal accountable person identity
verified_claims: Each building must have one principal accountable person; with multiple accountable persons, the party responsible for the structure and exterior is normally the PAP.
limitations: A PAP cannot be identified without building-specific ownership and lease evidence.

sources.name: Non-delegable accountability
verified_claims: Accountable persons may appoint agents to carry out duties, but their legal accountability and liability remain with them.
limitations: Use of a managing agent does not transfer statutory accountability.

sources.name: Single point of contact
verified_claims: A PAP organisation may name a person or third party as BSR contact, but this does not make that person or third party the PAP.
limitations: A contact record is not evidence of legal ownership or accountable-person status.

sources.name: Complex lease repairing obligation
verified_claims: In complex leaseholds, accountable-person status follows ownership or a relevant obligation to repair or maintain common parts.
limitations: The repairing obligation must be verified from legal documents.

sources.name: AP and fire responsible-person coordination
verified_claims: Where accountable persons and Fire Safety Order responsible persons differ, building safety information must be shared and data-protection requirements observed.
limitations: Information sharing does not merge the distinct statutory roles.

sources.name: Fire and structural safety duties
verified_claims: Accountable persons assess and manage risks from structural failure or spread of fire in the parts for which they are responsible.
limitations: A general duty does not establish that a specific hazard exists in a building.

sources.name: Reporting, engagement and information duties
verified_claims: Accountable persons must report safety occurrences, support resident engagement, keep golden-thread information and provide required building information.
limitations: The existence of these duties does not prove that each duty has been fulfilled for a named building.

sources.name: Residence access notice
verified_claims: Before accessing a residence to assess or manage building safety risks, an accountable person must normally request access in writing at least 48 hours in advance and explain why.
limitations: The power is conditional and does not permit unannounced entry.

sources.name: Multiple accountable-person cooperation
verified_claims: Multiple accountable persons must work together and share safety information about the building.
limitations: Cooperation requirements do not remove each party's responsibility for its own parts.

sources.name: Long-lease fire-spread boundary
verified_claims: For long-lease units, accountable persons must prevent risks in units affecting common parts and protect units from risks in areas they control.
limitations: This duty does not prove the presence or absence of compartmentation defects in a unit.

sources.name: Registration information changes
verified_claims: The PAP must submit structural and fire-safety information at registration and notify BSR of changes to submitted information.
limitations: A change notification is not evidence that the underlying change is safe or unsafe.

sources.name: Competence and organisational capability
verified_claims: Accountable persons must have relevant competence or appoint competent help, and should continually monitor appointed persons' competence and capacity.
limitations: Qualifications or standards alone do not guarantee compliance with all legal duties.
